response.justification: Bogdan has extensive fullstack experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js, along with a strong background in relational databases (SQL, MongoDB) and modern web architectures. While his experience leans more toward senior roles, his pragmatic approach to software development and collaborative mindset align well with the role's requirements. His AWS, Kubernetes, and clean architecture focus further strengthen his fit. The lack of direct PostgreSQL experience is a minor gap but not a dealbreaker given his broader database expertise.
strengths: Strong fullstack experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js across multiple roles
Proven track record in scalable systems, cloud-native development (AWS, Kubernetes), and clean architecture
Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies, with a focus on team collaboration and pragmatic solutions
concerns: Overqualified for an entry-level role with extensive senior/expert-level experience
Limited direct experience with PostgreSQL (though familiar with SQL and MongoDB)
High on-site presence requirement may conflict with his current remote-friendly work history
